title: Onion Wizard Over Mountain Lake
description: A large anthropomorphic purple onion with angry white eyes, wearing a green bow tie, floats in the night sky above a stylized mountain range. It holds a banana like a wand in one hand while wind chimes and metallic objects hang from its long green braided tentacles.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a giant anthropomorphic purple onion character with angry eyes and a green bow tie floating in a starry night sky. The onion has long flowing green braided tentacles from which many silver wind chimes and metal objects hang. It holds a yellow banana in one hand like a magic wand. Below is a vibrant green mountain range covered in glowing yellow and purple spiral patterns, reflecting in a bright blue lake with a glowing circular portal on the water surface.
